evals.prompt: kerpo-skill-from-script ei tunnistanut Python-skriptiäni oikein — se yritti ajaa sen bash-ohjeilla. Haluaisin raportoida tämän bugina.
evals.expected_output: Agent asks for confirmation details, drafts a bug report issue using the bug template with skill name 'kerpo-skill-from-script', shows it to the user, and creates the issue on KerpoOrg/kerpo-skills with label 'bug'. Returns the issue URL.

evals.prompt: Olisi hyödyllistä jos kerpo-skills-paketissa olisi skilli joka auttaa kirjoittamaan git commit-viestejä Kerpo Org konventioiden mukaan. Voitko ehdottaa tätä feature requestina?
evals.expected_output: Agent drafts a feature request issue using the feature-request template, fills in the proposed skill and use case, shows draft to user, and creates issue with label 'feature-request'.
Agent explains it can create a GitHub issue on KerpoOrg/kerpo-skills and asks the user what type of feedback (bug, feature request, or general feedback) and which skill it concerns.
